cohort: 19,416 nulliparous women at term and 1,747 primiparous women who attempted labor after prior caesarean (TOLAC)
finding: Previous caesarean delivery, whether urgent or elective, was associated with an increased risk of instrumental delivery in the subsequent pregnancy.
mod_finding: The study found that women who attempted labor after a previous cesarean section (TOLAC) had a higher rate of instrumental deliveries compared to nulliparous women.
